title: Beads Bridge MVP
description: A lightweight text-to-Beads bridge that accepts natural language commands via Discord, interprets them using Claude, and executes corresponding bd commands on the local machine. Fire-and-forget with reaction emoji feedback.

comments.author: who
comments.text:
**Blocker Investigation**:
The epic has 4 child features (bb-yb8, bb-pdg, bb-96g, bb-mjm), all with status 'open'.
However, all children are blocked because they depend ON this epic (bb-uqa).

This creates a circular dependency issue:
- Epic cannot close until children complete
- Children are blocked waiting for epic

**Resolution needed**: Remove the dependency from children back to the epic, so children can be worked on and then the epic can close when all children are complete.

comments.author: who
comments.text:
**Dependency Fix**:
- Removed circular dependencies (children depended on epic, creating deadlock)
- Added proper dependency: epic now depends on bb-mjm (End-to-End Verification)
- bb-mjm depends on bb-pdg and bb-96g, creating proper dependency chain
- Fixed bb-yb8 which also incorrectly depended on epic

**Status**: Epic is blocked waiting for child features (bb-pdg, bb-96g) to complete, then bb-mjm, then this epic can close.
